convert_model_weights: convert GLM-ASR model weights from original checkpoint to Hugging Face format and save to output directory
push_model_to_hub: convert GLM-ASR model weights and push the converted model and processor to a Hugging Face Hub repository
permute_rope_weights: permute RoPE tensor weights to match Hugging Face's interleaved rope implementation
convert_weight_keys: convert original checkpoint weight keys to Hugging Face key names using regex-based mapping
build_cli_converter: build a CLI tool to convert GLM-ASR model weights to Hugging Face format with safetensors support
